tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo bzhugs so/ /

rin chen shog dkar gyi skor/ gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ ston pa phun sum tshogs pa dpal rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shes bya'i mkha' la mkhyen rab sprin tshogs mdzad pa'i klog gi phreng ba can/ /thugs rje'i 'brug sgra phyogs kyi mthar khyab phan bde'i char rgyun legs 'bebs pa/ /'gro ba'i bla ma dkon mchog gsum de skye dgu'i mkha' la mdzes pa yi/ /bdag gzhan gtsug gi nor bus zhabs mchod yun ring bkra shis byed par shog /gang 'dir bdag blo'i yid kyi pad+ma la/ /byin rlabs nyin byed zer gyis phog pa yis/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis sgrub la 'dab stong rgyas/ /de slad gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lor bshad/ /de'ang 'dir snying po'i rgyud rdzogs pa rang byung gi rjes su 'brangs nas tshe 'das rjes su gzung ba'i cho ga brjod par bya'o/ / 'di la nub dang po bya ba'i rim pa dang*/ lhag ma rnams su bya ba'i rim pa gnyis las/ dang po la sa'i cho ga dang*/ sngon 'gro legs par bsham pa dang*/ me tog tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor dngos ji ltar mchod pa gsum las/ dang po ni sa'i cho ga bsang sbyangs dgos pa'i phyogs su/ maṇ+ḍal zlum po khru gang pa ba byung dang*/ dris byug pa'i dbus su/ ā+oṃ pri thi dhe wīs dri'i thig le dang*/ me tog gi tshom bu bkod la/ de'i drung du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma gsum bshams la/ rang nyid skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed nas/ skad cig gis kun bzang yab yum du bsgoms te/ a mṛ tas bsang zhing*/ swabhā was sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngang las tshom bu nyid/ pad zla'i steng du paṃ las sa'i lha mo ser mo bum pa 'dzin par bskyed nas/ lha mo chen mo sa bdag 'jig rten yum/ /rin chen rdzogs dbang mchog gi rgyan gyis brgyan/ /do shal rkang gdub sgra sgrogs sems dpas mchod/ / mchod yon 'di bzhes 'di ru byin rlob mdzod/

/ā+oṃ pṛ thi de wī sa ma ya dzaḥdzaḥ zhes pas sa bon las 'od 'phros/ sa'i 'og nas lha mo sa bdag klu gnyan gyis bskor ba spyan drangs la dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ yi ge gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ dri med yid 'ong bdud rtsi yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /lha mo la ni bdag 'bul gyis/ /sa 'di bdag la gnang du gsol/ /ā+oṃ pri thi dhe wī ar+ghaṃ pra ti tsa ye swāhā/ tshig des mchod pa lhag ma rnams kyang mchod nas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par du/ /sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /shākya seng ge skyob pa yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/ /bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa che ge mo zhes bya bas/ che ge mo'i don du sa phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po bzheng gis/ lha mo khyod kyis sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang bar mdzod cig /ces brjod pas des kyang rig pa 'dzin pa khyod kyis ci dga' bar byos shig /ces gsungs bar bsams la/ gtor ma dang po de lha mo 'khor bcas la 'bul/ gnyis pa de dkar po'i phyogs la byin nas/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ / sa 'di bdag gis slong bar bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor don du stsal du gsol/ / dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar phyin pa'i grogs mdzad du gsol/ ces brjod/ gsum pa de nag po'i phyogs la byin nas/ sa phyogs 'dir ni slob dpon bdag /dkyil 'khor rgyal po sgyu 'phrul ni/ /bzheng gis sa 'dir gnas pa'i bgegs/ /'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ /ā+oṃ sum bha ni dang gu gul gyis bdug la/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra muḥs lha mo 'khor bcas gshegs par bsams te/ /gyau mo dang rus pa la sogs dor nas/ /sa mnyen bzang po la stegs bu gru bzhi pa me long gi ngos ltar 'jam zhing snyoms pa/

shar dang byang cung zad gzhol pa'i/ steng dang khor yul tu lag mthil g.yas bskor zhing*/ /ā+oṃ ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa kyis 'od zer byung bas ma dag pa sbyangs/ ā+oṃ bhu khang gis sa phyogs thams cad nam mkhar gyur/ ā+oṃ me de ni badz+ra bha bhan+dha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ kyis rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ ā+oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa phaṭa kyis bsrung zhing brtan par bya'o/ /sa'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa ni srad bu dkyil 'khor nyis 'gyur du byas pa'i sna slob dpon gtso bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas shar du bltas la/ slob ma mi bskyod pa'i nga rgyal gyis nub tu bltas te/ dza zhes brjod cing gtad nas tshangs thig la sogs pa gdab cing*/ cha chen bcu drug rdzogs pa na/ /dang po phyed gdab phyi ma gdab/ /gnyis pa cha bzhir bgo byas te/ /gsum pa bzhi pa mi gdab bzhag /lnga pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ /drug pa phyed gdab phyi ma gdab/ /bdun pa cha bzhir bgo byas te/ / brgyad pa dbus dor mtha' gnyis gdab/ de'ang dbang chog ltar ye shes kyi thig gdab pa'ang byas na legs so/ /de nas lha'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i tshom bu bkod pa'i mthar mchod gtor bsham mo/ /gsum pa ni bdag nyid bskyed cing mchod bstod byas te/ dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod bstod byas pa'i rjes/ ho dgongs su gsol/ rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum khor dang bcas/ /sems dpa' sems ma ma lus bdag la dgongs/ /rgyal ba sras bcas mchod pa dang*/ /tshe 'das khyod kyi rjes gzhug phyir/ /bdag ni che ge zhes bgyi bas/ /nangs par rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bri/ khyed kyi thugs rjes dgongs mdzod la/ /byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ /ces mkhyen par gsol bas/ gtso bo'i zhal nas/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis sems can gyi don du dkyil 'khor chen po'i las rtsoms shig /gsungs par bsam nas/ gtor ma bsngos/ bzod par gsol/ bsngo ba byas/ bdag nyid bsrungs nas/ sang me tog tshom bu'i lha rnams la/

mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas te/ badz+ra mus ye shes pa dkyil 'khor gyi nam mkhar bteg nas dam tshig pa bsdus te/ yi ge brgya pa brjod cing tshom bu dang mchod pa rnams re zhig dben par bsdu'o/ /gnyis pa nub lhag mar bya ba'i rim pa la/ dkyil 'khor bri zhing sku legs par bsham pa dang*/ cho ga dngos ji ltar bya ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ tshon rnams dbus dang phyogs bzhir rigs lnga'i kha dog bzhin bkod la/ ā+oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥrnams bris te/ rigs lngar bskyed nas ye shes pa bcug /mchod bstod mdor bsdus byas la/ lha rnams 'od du zhu ba'i tshon ye shes lngar bsams la/ slob dpon gyis shar nas tshon thogs te/ sangs rgyas rigs lnga yi shes gtso/ /kun gyi don rig bya ba'i phyir/ /ye shes lnga yi tshon dgye 'o/ /zhes pas re khā bṛ'o/ /de'i tshon gyis bri ba ni/ /dbus su 'dab brgyad mu khyud gsum/ /dbus mthing shar dkar lho ser zhing*/ / nub dmar byang ljang shar lho dmar/ /lho nub ljang gu nub byang dkar/ /byang shar ser pos dgang bar bya/ /mu khyud mthing dmar dkar pos bskor/ /gru dang lha snam phyogs mdog la/ /phyogs mtshams thig le gnyis gnyis dgod/ /sgo bzhir thig le re re bya/ /rtsig pa lnga ni nang rim bzhin/ /mthing ga ljang dmar ser dang dkar/ /'dod yon dmar la pha gu ser/ /dra phyed sngo la mda' yab dmar/ /pu shu mdzes tshon zhing khams ljang*/ /rta babs mdzes tshon chu srin dmar/ /rdo rje'i rwa ni phyogs kyi mdog /nyi zla dmar dkar dur khrod brgyad/ /phyogs mtshams pad+ma sna tshogs mdog /rdo rje mthing la me ri dmar/ /yang na ye shes rnam lnga'i mdog /srab mthug med cing snyoms par bri/ /de dag gi khor yug kun tu chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i phyi mchod dang*/ bdud rtsi sman rag la sogs pa nang mchod rnams legs par bshams/ bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings ldan pa gnyis kyang sman dang 'bru dang chus bkang la bzhag

/sngon 'gro gtor ma gnyis dang*/ gzhan lnga yang bshams/ bye ma sol phor/ ting lo changs bu la sogs pa 'dir dgos pa rnams tshogs par byas la/ yol ba bla bre bris sku la sogs pa'ang dgram mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ thams cad kyi spyod lam bstun la thog mar mchod pa bsang sbyangs ni/ ku shas bsang chu gtor nas/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ar+ghaṃ/ pāt+yaṃḥ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā le ke/ ghan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shab+ta ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ yongs su gyur pa las phyi nang gi mchod pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pas sa dang bar snang kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bus gang bar gyur/ tshe las 'das pas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o/ /sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das zhi khrau rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /chos thams cad stong zhing bdag med pa yin pa la/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can thams cad snying re rje/ de dag thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bsgom/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang 'phrad par gyur cig / sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu thams cad dang bral bar gyur cig / dga' ba chen po dang dus rtag tu mi 'bral bar gyur cig /bde sdug gi rgyu chags sdang thams cad dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la gnas par gyur cig /ā+oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe sarba dharmā swa bhā wa bi shud+dho ྅haṃ/ phyi dang nang gi chos thams cad stong pa chen po/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hrīḥlas 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpa' bo rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbyug tho dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'i pang na/

rdo rje phag mo dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang rin po che dang rus pa dang thod pa'i phreng bas rab tu brgyan pa/ spyan gsum pa khro bo'i lta stangs chen pos bskal ba'i me ri me dpung gi dbus na bzhugs pa'i lkog mar hrīḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa/ rtsa ba mgrin par zug cing lo 'dab lkog mar rgyas pa'i mdun gyi 'dab ma'i lce'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su/ hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po nyal thabs su gnas pa 'od du zhu zla ba la thim/ de 'od du zhu lce la thim pas rdo rje'i lcer gyur/ ā+oṃ badz+ra dzi hā lag pa'i mthil gnyis su a a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i dbus su hūṃ hūṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa gyen du 'greng ba re re 'od du zhu ba las zla ba la thim/ zla ba zhu ba lag pa la thim pas rdo rje'i lag par gyur/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad rdo rje'i ra ba gur bla bre ye shes kyi me ri me phung 'bar ba'i dal chen por gyur/ hūṃ rab 'jigs phra men khro mo'i sku/ / badz+ra sing ha seng ge'i gdong*/ /badz+ra bya kri stag gdong ma/ /mthing nag mtshon cha me 'od 'phro/ /gti mug dbang bsgyur las mkhan ma/ /steng 'og dgra bgegs mtshams chod cig /hūṃ rab 'jigs phra men khro mo'i sku/ /kang ka mu kha bya rog gdong*/ /dkar gsal mtshon cha me 'od 'phro/ /zhe sdang dbang bsgyur las mkhan ma/ /shar sgo'i dgra bgegs mtshams chod cig /hūṃ rab 'jigs phra men khro mo'i sku/ /hu lu mu kha 'ug gdong ma/ /ljang nag mtshon cha me 'od 'phro/ /phrag dog dbang bsgyur las mkhan la/ /byang sgo'i dgra bgegs mtshams chod cig /hūṃ rab 'jigs phra men khro mo'i sku/ /shwa na mu kha khyi gdong ma/ /dmar nag mtshon cha me 'od 'phro/ /'dod chags dbang bsgyur las mkhan ma/

/nub sgo'i dgra bgegs mtshams chod cig /hūṃ rab 'jigs phra men khro'i mo'i sku/ /su ra ka seng phag gdong ma/ /ser nag mtshon cha me 'od 'phro/ /nga rgyal dbang bsgyur las mkhan ma/ /lho sgo'i dgra bgegs mtshams chod cig /ā+oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha hūṃ/ /ā+oṃ ghṛ h+ṇa ghṛ h+na hūṃ/ ā+oṃ ghṛh+ṇa pa ya ghṛh+na pa ya hūṃ/ ā+oṃ a na ya ho/ bha ga wan bid+ya ra tsa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ phyogs mtshams steng 'og thams cad rdo rje me ri'i rwa ba gnyis pas 'bar bar gyur/ hūṃ ye shes bskal ba me ltar bar ba'i 'od/ /ma rig 'dod pa'i mun khams thams cad bsregs/ /zhe sdang gshin rje'i 'jig rten thams cad 'joms/ /dpa' bo chen po dpa' mtshan stag lpags can/ /log 'dren srin po'i mtha' gnon dgra 'dul ba/ /rig pa'i rgyal po khro bo bzhugs so 'tshal/ /log 'dren 'dul ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /'gro ba'i don du mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /steng gi nam mkhar khro bo dbang chen dpag tu med pa byon/ /ā+oṃ ma hā ko ta sa pā ri wā ra/ /ar+ghaṃ pa t+yaṃ puṣ+paṃ d+dhu paṃ ā lo ke ghan+he ni wi t+ya shab+ta āḥhūṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs bdag la gnyis su med par thim/ / hūṃ chos nyid stong pa gnyis med ngang nyid las/ /'jig rten spyod pa'i tshul yang mi spong zhing/ /thams la mkhas pas 'jigs byed skur ston pa/ khro chen 'bar ba'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ye shes zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /sku yi cha lugs byed rngam stabs can/ /gsung gi nga ro 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgras/ /ma rungs dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /lhag pa'i ye shes rol pa ston mdzad cing*/ /bsdigs pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ /nyon mongs dug chen rtsad nas 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /sbrul gdug rgyan gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūṃ bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas/ /dpa' bo'i stangs stabs brkyang bskum tshul du bzhugs/

/nyi zla 'bar ba'i spyan gyis sdang mig gis/ /bgegs dpung sreg par mdzad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūṃ gtum chen dus mtha'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /glog stong 'gyu 'dra'i khro gnyer mche ba gtsigs/ /rngam ba'i nga ro 'brug sgra stong sgrogs shing*/ /khro rgyal bgegs tshogs 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūṃ dbang chen bskal ba'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ /dbu skra kham ser spyan gsum sdang mig bgrad/ /mche ba gtsigs shing brkyang bskum 'jigs pa'i sku/ /dpal chen yab yum gnyis la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūṃ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs/ /lus ngag yid gsum gnod pa'i bgegs/ /bar chad 'byung po thams cad kun/ /'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ /nga ni dpal chen rta mgrin rgyal/ /rdo rje 'dzin byed 'bar ba'i sku/ /nga yi bka' las 'das gyur na/ /thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag par 'gyur/ ā+oṃ shṝ badz+ra ha ya gh+ri wa ra tsa hri ya ha ri ni sa rak+ṣa u tsa ta ya hūṃ phaṭa/ bgegs thams cad rgya mtsho'i mthar byer nas/ ye shes kyi me phung gcig tu 'bar bar gyur/ ā+oṃ badz+ras twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ sarba sa twa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha ḍā+-i ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ u nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra ma me muñtsa/ badz+rī bha wa/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa ā/ ā+oṃ yo ga shud+dhoḥsarba dharmā swa bhā wa bi shud+dho ྅haṃ/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba/ raṃlas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ mthing nag las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rang bzhin gzhi'i kun tu bzang po/ mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba/ e las chos nyid kun tu bzang mo sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa gnyis ka'ang rdo rje'i skyil mo krung rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi zla'i dbus su/

rdo rje sngon po'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa'i rwa lnga la/ ā+oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥs mtshan pa'i phyi rol du ā li bcu drug dang*/ kā li rnams mar me'i phreng ba ltar 'od gsal ba'o/ /lag pa'i mthil gnyis su a hūṃ/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du hūṃ/ hūṃ gis mtha' skor gnyis na phar/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ mchog tu dkar zhing 'od gsal ba rnams kyis gang bar gyur/ sor mo rnams la a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal g.yas pa'i sor mo la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng*/ rigs lnga yab kyi sa bon rim ba bzhin du/ ā+oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.a las rnam par snang mdzad/ mi bskyod pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ 'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa/ rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ rdo rje thugs ma/ rdo rje dbang bskur ma/ rdo rje mtshon cha ma/ rdo rje rkun mo rnams/ phan tshun lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin/ sku mdog phyag mtshan la sogs pa 'dra'o/ ā+oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrī āḥ e raṃ laṃ taṃ yaṃ/ lha rnams phan tshun dgyes shing snyoms par zhugs par gyur/ hūṃ kun tu bzang po bde gshegs rigs lnga'i gtso/ /ye shes mchog gis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /rang bzhin dbyings nas thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul gyis/ /yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ /ye shes pa steng gi nam mkhar byon pa la/ ā+oṃ phyi nang gsang ba bla na med pa yis/ /mchod pa'i sprin phung rab 'byams rgya mtsho rnams/ /ma lus blo yis blangs te gus 'bul gyis/ /thugs rjes tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū tsa me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ ngang nyid chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*/ /thugs rje'i rnam 'phrul sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i lha/ /kun bzang yab yum gnyis la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hos bdag la gnyis su med par thim/

ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ gis sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlab/ ā+oṃ budha a bhi ṣiñtsa ā+oṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/ ā+oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ ā+oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ/ ā+oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa aḥ/ sbyi bo'i gnas lngar rigs lngas dbu brgyan par gyur/ thugs kar pad zla'i steng gi rdo rje dang*/ sngags rnams las 'od zer byung bas/ snod bcud thams cad lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin du gyur/ tshe las 'das pa'i sdig pa thams cad sbyangs/ 'od zer gyi 'phro 'dus sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho ston par dmigs te bzlas pa bgyi 'tshal/ /ā+oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrī aḥ a ā i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ che ge mo'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shan+ting ku ru ye swāhā/ slar yang bdag bskyed la mchod bstod bgyi 'tshal/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ phyi nang gi mchod sprin sa dang bar snang gang bar gyur/ hūṃ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i 'jig rten na/ /mchod yon ji snyid yod pa dang*/ / bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū tsa me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ hūṃ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i 'jig rten na/ /me tog ji snyed yod pa dang*/ bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ hūṃ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i 'jig rten na/ / bdus spos ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūṃ/ hūṃ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i 'jig rten na/ /snang gsal ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/

hūṃ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i 'jig rten na/ /dri chab ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūṃ/ /hūm̐ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i 'jig rten na/ /zhal zas ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /rgyal brgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra nai wi te āḥhūm̐/ /hūm̐ phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i 'jig rten na/ /sil snyan ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra shab+ta āḥhūṃ/ hūṃ snod bcud snang srid 'jig rten kun/ /rdo rje gzugs sgra dri dang ro/ /reg bya'i tshogs su kun sprul te/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ma hā pū tsa āḥhūṃ/ hūṃ gsang ba'i lha mo yid 'ong ma/ /so so'i gzugs mdzes rig ma yis/ /sku gsum bde chen rgyas mdzad ma/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra dhe ba ta āḥhūṃ/ hūṃ rang bzhin gdod ma'i mgon po ni/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho kun gyi yab/ /sangs rgyas kun las sngar sangs rgyas/ /lhun gyis grub la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ma skyes chos dbyings byang chub sems/ /thog mtha' med pa'i mkha' klong nas/ /dus sum rgyal ba skyed mdzad ma/ /kun tu bzang mor phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rang bzhin chos sku dag pa'i ngang*/ /sna tshogs thabs mkhas thugs rje yis/ / rigs lnga ye shes lngar ston pa/ /lha yi lha la phyag 'tshal bstaud/ /bum pa bsgrub pa la 'jug par ba gyi/ /ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ/ ā+oṃ sa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho ྅haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ ā ཿlas zla ba/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ bhūṃ bhūṃ las rnam par rgyal ba dang*/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa rin po che sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin/ yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba zhabs zhum pa/ mchu 'phyangs ba/ mgrin pa phra ba dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa/

lha'i gos pañtsa li kas mgrin pa dkris la/ phyi bum pa'i dbyibs can la/ nang lha'i gzhal med khang du gnas pa'i/ nam par rgyal ba'i bum par dbus su sed+ge'i khri/ shar du glang po che/ lhor rta/ nub tu rma bya/ byang du shang shang gi steng rnams su pad+ma dang zla ba'i dbus su/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga so so'i sku mdog dang*/ phyag mtshan yum dang bcas pa rdzogs par gyur/ las thams cad pa'i bum par pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dbus su dpa' bo rta mgrin yab yum khro bo'i rgyan cha lugs chen po gsal bar gyur/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ ye shes pa byon/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlab/ ā+oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa ā+oṃ/ badz+ra/ rat+na/ pad+ma/ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa ā/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ bdag gi sa snying ga nas 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril te song bas rnam par rgyal ba'i lha rnams la phog

bde ba'i sgras bskul/ snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs par bsams la bzla bar bgyi/ ā+oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ slar yang las thams cad pa'i bum pa snga ma bzhin dmigs te bzlas pa re bgyi/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī hūṃḥ mchod yon me tog bdug spos dang*/ snang gsal dri chab zhal zas dang*/ rol mo la sogs mchod pa'i sprin/ ji snyed kun gyis rgyal ba mchod/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ar+gha pa t+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhu pai ā lo ke ghan+bhe nai wi te shab+ta ā hūṃ/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gdod nas rang byung sku lnga lhun gyis grub/ /phung po gnas gyur ye shes lnga yi dngos/ /bde gshegs yab yum dbang chen yab yum la/ /gnyis med 'du 'bral med pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / ā+oṃ badz+ra muḥye shes pa gshegs/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor chen po bsgrub par bgyi/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ shu n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa shud+dho ྅haṃ/ phyi dang nang gi chos thams cad stong pa chen po/ ā+oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho ྅haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hūṃ yaṃ hūṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang gu gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu mchog ma ba dan la yaṃ gis mtshan pa hūṃ raṃ hūṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum pa raṃ gyis mtshan pa hūṃ baṃ hūṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ hūṃ laṃ hūṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po laṃ gyis mtshan pa/ hūṃ suṃ hūṃ las ri'i rgyal po'i ri rab kyi steng du/

hūṃ baṃ hūṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ hūṃ a hūṃ las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ hūṃ raṃ hūṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mchog tu mthing ga'i dbus su/ hūṃ bh+ruṃ hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten la phog /ma dag pa thams cad sbyangs/ 'og min gyi zhing khams shin tu nyams dga' bar gyur/ slar 'dus bh+rūṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang pa sgo bzhi gru bzhi rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa rnams kyang nang nas rim pa bzhin/ mthing ga/ ljang gu dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po rnams kyi steng na rin po che'i pha gu ser po la/ nor bu'i dra ba/ dril bu g.yer kha/ rnga ma'i chun po/ dar gyi lda ldi la sogs pa 'phyangs pa/ de'i steng na rdo karma shi la las grub pa'i mda' yab rin po che'i rnam par spel ba'i steng na/ rin po che'i drwa mig /gseng ma'i pū shus yongs su bskor ba/ rtsig pa rnams kyi phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu la/ lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas gzhal yas khang pa'i lha rnams la mchod pa'i sprin gyi 'od zer chen po 'gyed pa/ sgo rnams kyi steng ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi bzhi dang ldan pa rnams la/ rin po che'i gdugs/ chos kyi 'khor lo/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i ri dwags/ lha'i gos/ rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ yid du 'ong ba'i 'phan/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa/ rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pas brgyan pa'i/ nang ka ba chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i steng*/ rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mangs ris su phug pa'i dbus/ phyur bu rab tu mtho ba'i rtse mo dang phyogs bzhi'i rta babs phyur bu rnams kyi rtse mo thod pa dang*/ rdo rje dang nor bu rin po che'i tog gis mdzes pa'i kha khyer bzhi bzhi la/

ba dan nyi shu rtsa bzhi thod pa la 'phyangs pa'i gser gyi dril bu g.yer khas bres pa/ phy-i mchod rten rtsai lnga pa la nang lha'i gzhal yas khang pa phyi nas bltas na nang gsal ba/ nang nas bltas na phyi gsal ba/ ye shes rin po'i che'i ngo bo las grub pa/ 'od zer chen po rab tu 'bar bas/ 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa rgyas par 'gengs pa'i phyi rol na/ dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba/ me brgyad dang chu brgyad/ shing brgyad dang sprin brgyad/ grub thob kyi slob dpon brgyad/ zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro brgyad la sogs pas mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ me ri me phung gis bskor ba'i gzhal med khang chen po'i dbus su/ ā+oṃ saṃ ā+oṃ las sed+ge'i khri/ hūṃ ga hūṃ las shar du glang po che'i khri/ trāṃ tha trāṃ las lhor rta mchog gi khri/ hrī maṃ hrī las nub tu rma bya'i khri/ a gaṃ a las byang du shang shang gi khri rnams kyi steng du/ paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/ dbus nas phyogs bzhir rim pa bzhin/ ā+oṃ hūṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.a/ e baṃ laṃ raṃ yaṃ las 'od zer gyi dra ba chen po rab tu 'phros pas/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rab tu snang bar byas so/ /snang bar byas pas sems can thams cad kyi las dang sgrib pa sbyangs te/ lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin du gyur/ slar 'dus ā+oṃ e yongs su gyur pas dbus su bcom lda na 'das rnam par snang mdzad dang dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma/ mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis mdzes shing*/ yab kyi phyag g.yas 'khor los yu ba byas pa'i rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gyi phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas/ mnyam par sbyor ba'i thugs kar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dbus su ā+oṃ gyi mthar/ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.as bskor ba las 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba'o/

/hūṃ baṃ yongs su gyur pa las shar du mi bskyod pa dang mā ma kī dkar mo/ yab kyi g.yas rdo rjes yu ba byas pa'i rdo rje dang*/ thugs kar pad zla nyi ma'i dbus su hūṃ gi mthar/ ā+oṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.as bskor ba/ trām̐ laṃ las lho rin chen 'byung ldan dang sangs rgyas spyan ma ser mo yab kyi g.yas rin po ches yu ba byas pa'i rdo rje dang*/ thugs kar trāṃ gi mthar hūṃ ā+oṃ hrīḥ.as bskor ba/ hrīḥraṃ las nub tu snang ba mtha' yas dang gos dkar mo dmar mo yab kyi g.yas pad+mas yu ba byas pa'i rdo rje dang*/ thugs kar hrī'i mthar hūṃ trāṃ ā+oṃ as bskor ba/ a yaṃ las byang du don yon grub pa dang dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu /yab kyi g.yas rgya gram gyis yu ba byas pa'i rdo rje ral gri dang*/ thugs kar a'i mthar hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā+om̐ gyis bskor ba/ sa bon de dag thams cad kyi mtha' ā li dkar po dang*/ kā li dmar pos bskor ba/ yab thams cad kyi phyag g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum thams cad kyi phyag na gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ rdo rje'i skyil mo krung rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas brgyan pa'o/ de dag gi zur gyi grwa nang ma bzhir pad+ma dang nyi zla'i steng du hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.a gnyis gnyis las/ 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas shar lho/ hūṃ hūṃ las nam mkha'i snying po dkar po ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje sgeg mo dkar mo me long 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba trām̐ trāṃ las lho nub tu sa'i snying po ser po rin po che'i myu gu dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ phreng ba ma ser mo rin po che'i phreng ba 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba/ hrī hrī las nub byang du spyan ras gzigs dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ glu ma dmar mo pi wang 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba/ a a las byang shar du kun tu bzang po ljang gu /rin po che'i snye ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ gar ma ljang gu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba'o/

yang phyi rol gyis grwa bzhir/ pad+ma dang nyi zla'i dbus su/ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.a gnyis gnyis las/ mer hūṃ hūṃ las byams pa dkar po klu shing dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ bdug spos ma dkar mo 'dug spos kyi khang pa 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba/ trāṃ trāṃ las srin por sgrib pa rnams sel ser po po ti dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ me tog ma ser mo me tog gi za ma tog 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba/ hrī hrī las rlung du 'jam dpal dmar po ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ snang gsal ma dmar mo mar me'i kong bu 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ a a las dbang ldan du phyag na rdo rje ljang gu rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dri chab ma ljang gu dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba/ de thams cad kyang sems dpa'i skyil mo krung rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i thugs kar rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa'o/ /de dag gi sku'i rtsal las shar gyi snam bu la thag bzang ris mthing ga go cha 'dzin pa/ lhor shākya thub pa ser po 'khar gsil dang lhung bzed 'dzin pa/ nub tu sed+ge rab brten mthing ga po ti 'dzin pa/ byang du kha 'bar dhe ba dmar po rin po che'i sgrom bu 'dzin pa/ steng du brgya byin dkar po pi wang 'dzin pa/ 'og tu a ba glang mgo nag po me chu bsnams pa rnams pad zla'i steng na bzhengs pa'i tshul gyis sprul pa'i sku'i rgyan dang ldan pa'o/ / sgo bzhir pad+ma dang nyi zla'i steng du/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis gnyis las shar du dza dza las khro bo rnam par rgyal ba dang sgo ma lcags kyu ma dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba/ hūṃ hūṃ las lho sgor khro bo gshin rje'i gshed po dang*/ sgo ma zhags pa ma ser mo zhags pa 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba/ baṃ baṃ las nub sgor khro bo rta mgrin rgyal ba dang*/ sgo ma lcags sgrog ma dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba/ ho ho las byang sgor khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang sgo ma dril bu ma ljang gu dril bu 'dzin pa dang sbyor ba/

de dag thams cad kyang khro bo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing thugs kar rang rang gi sa bon gyis mtshan pa/ khro bo'i stangs stabs kyis me ri me phung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de dag gi sku'i gdangs las/ steng na khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor me ri me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na shin tu 'jigs su rung ba me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar/ skad cig dran rdzogs kyis snang la rang bzhin med par bsam mo/ /rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgyas se gol dpung par bsnol te gtogs nas/ hūṃ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*/ /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ / bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ hūṃ dus gsum bla ma kun bzang chos kyi rje/ /nyon mongs lnga dag phung po gnas gyur pa'i/ /sku gsum lnga ldan rigs lnga yab yum gtso/ /'gro ba'i don phyir mchod kyis gshegs su gsol/ /ā+oṃ gu ru badz+ra hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.a/ sa ma ya dza dza/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad byon par bsam//hūṃ sgyu ma chu zla ye shes gzhal yas khang*/ /skyon bral pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs/ /ā+oṃ pad+ma sūr+ya tsan+d+ra ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ chu dang thang skyes me tog yid 'ongs rnams/ / dngos 'byor ting 'dzin dag pa'i mchod sprin gyis/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /thugs rjes tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta puṣ+pe pū tsa me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ a gar sih+la tsan+dan la sogs pa/ /dngos 'byor ting 'dzin dag pa'i mchod sprin gyis/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /thugs rjes tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dhū pe pū tsa me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ rin chen snang gsal nyi zla'i 'od 'phro ba/ /dngos 'byor ting nge 'dzin dag pa'i mchod sprin gyis/

/bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /thugs rjes tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā lo ke pū tsa me gha sa ma dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ rang bzhin lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba'i dri/ /dngos 'byor ting 'dzin dag pa'i mchod sprin gyis/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /thugs rjes tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ghan+dhe pū tsa me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ kha dog dri ldan ro brgya ldan pa'i zas/ /dngos 'byor ting 'dzin dag pa'i mchod sprin byas/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /thugs rjes tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ni wi te pū tsa me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ sil snyan dril chen rnams dkrol tshangs pa'i dbyangs//dngos 'byor ting 'dzin dag pa'i mchod sprin byas/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /thugs rjes tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ / ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shab+ta pū tsa me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin ni/ dngos 'byor ting 'dzin dag pa'i mchod sprin gyis/ /bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul/ /thugs rjes tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba pū tsa me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ sku gsung thugs nyid ye nas kun tu bzang*/ /sku lnga ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i lha/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'grau ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma kun bzang rigs lnga'i tshogs la bstod/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ ye shes pa rnams dam tshig pa'i dal du byon/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ so so'i spyi bor byon/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ gnyis su med par thim/ ā+oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya hoḥ dgyes shing brtan par gyur/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor ā+oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/

ā+oṃ bud+dha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣi ñtsa hūṃ/ ā+oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ ā+oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ ā+oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas bdud rtsi'i bum pa thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī hūṃ gis dbang bskur bas rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan par gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod pa'i sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pas sa dang nam mkha' kun tu khyab par gyur/ hūṃ phyogs bcur rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing khams na/ /me tog sprin phung nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /dngos dang yid kyis rnams sprul ji snyed kun/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gus pas mchod/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ phyogs bcu rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing khams na/ /bdug spos sprin phung nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /dngos dang yid kyis rnam sprul ji snyed kun/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gus pas mchod/ ā+oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūṃ/ phyogs bcu rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing khams na/ /snang gsal sprin phung nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /dngos dang yid kyis rnam sprul ji snyed kun/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gus pas mchod/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ phyogs bcu rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing khams na/ /dri chab sprin phung nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /dngos dang yid kyis rnam sprul ji snyed kun/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gus pas mchod/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ghan+de āḥhūṃ/ phyogs bcu rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing khams na/ /zhal zas sprin phung nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /dngos dang yid kyis rnam sprul ji snyed kun/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gus pas mchod*/ ā+oṃ badz+ra nai wi te āḥhūṃ/
phyogs bcu rab 'byams rgyal ba'i zhing khams na/ rol mo'i sprin phung nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa/ /dngos dang yid kyis rnam sprul ji snyed kun/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la gus pas mchod/

/ ā+oṃ badz+ra shab+ta āḥhūṃ/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun chad nas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra rat+na pū tsi te ( < a > pū dzi te ) āḥhūṃ/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas/ /bkres shing phongs pa rgyun chad de/ /'byor pa phun su tshogs par shog/ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi rat+na pū tsi ta ེ( < a > pū dzi te ) āḥhūṃ/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de/ /shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel par shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wa ti rat+na pū tsi te ( < a > pū dzi ta ེ) āḥhūm̐/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /blon po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan/ /bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*/ /yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā ta rat+na pū tsi te ( < a > pū dzi te ) āḥhūṃ/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /glang po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal te/ /bla med theg par rab zhon nas/ /thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta hasti rat+na pū tsi te ( < a > pū dzi te ) pāḥhūṃ/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing du bgrod par shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tu raṃ ga a shwa thā rat+na pū tsi te ( < a > pū dzi te ) ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas/ /nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de/ /snyems bral mchog ni thob par shog /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ṣat+ga rat+na pū tsi te ( < a > pū dzi te ) āḥhūṃ/ /hūṃ snod bcud snang srid sna tshogs yid 'ong gzugs/

/rdo rje gzugs ma'i tshogs su kun sprul te/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod par bgyi/ /thugs rjes tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra rū pa pra ti dza hūm̐/ /snod bcud snang srid sna tshogs yid 'ong sgra /rdo rje sgra ma'i tshogs su kun sprul te/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod par bgyi/ /thugs rjes tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra shab+ta hūṃ/ /snod bcud snang srid sna tshogs dri zhim spos/ /rdo rje dri ma'i tshogs su kun sprul te/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod par bgyi/ /thugs rjes tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol//ā+oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe hūm̐/ snod bcud snang srid sna tshogs ro ldan zas/ /rdo rje ro ma'i tshogs su kun sprul te/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho tshogs la mchod par bgyi/ / thugs rjes tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra nai wi te hūṃ/ snod bcud snang srid sna tshogs bde ba'i ro/ /rdo rje reg ma'i tshogs su kun sprul te/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod par bgyi/ /thugs rjes tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra par+she hūṃ/ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' bsdus pas na/ /rdo rje'i rin chen bla na med/ /rdo rje chos kyi glu blangs pas/ /rdo rje las kun byed par 'gyur/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra lā s+ye hūṃ/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra mā le trām̐/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ghā+-irti hrī/ ā+oṃ badz+ra nīrti ā/ ā+om̐ badz+ra dhū pe hūm̐/ ā+oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe trām̐/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ ā+oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe ā/ ā+oṃ badz+ra sa twa su saṃ kra ha/ ā+oṃ badz+ra rat+na ma nu ta ri raṃ/ ā+oṃ badz+ra pad+ma ka ya ni/ ā+oṃ badz+ra karma a rong bha we/ hūṃ gsang mchog sku yi bde chen rig ma ni/ /sku mdog dkar mdzes me long pad+ma bsnams/ /shin tu yid 'ong bde gshegs dgyes mdzad ma/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs kun mnyes gyur cig /ā+oṃ badz+ra a dhar she āḥhūṃ/

gsang mchog gsung gi bde chen rig ma ni/ /sku mdog dmar mdzes rnga zlum sgra sgrogs ma/ /shin tu yid 'ong bde gshegs dgyes mdzad ma/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs kun mnyes gyur cig / ā+oṃ badz+ra mu rañdze āḥhūṃ/ gsang mchog thugs kyi bde chen rig ma ni/ /sku mdog mthing mdzes pi wang sgra sgrogs ma/ /shin tu yid 'ong bde gshegs dgyes mdzad ma/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs kun mnyes gyur cig /ā+oṃ badz+ra wi ni āḥhūṃ/ /gsang mchog yon tan bde chen rig ma ni/ /sku mdog ser mdzes gling bu'i sgra sgrogs ma/ /shin tu yid 'ong bde gshegs dgyes mdzad ma/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs kun mnyes gyur cig /ā+oṃ badz+ra waṃ se āḥhūṃ/ gsang mchog phrin las bde chen rig ma ni/ /sku mdog ljang mdzes rdza rnga'i sgra sgrogs ma/ /shin tu yid 'ong bde gshegs dgyes mdzad ma/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs kun mnyes gyur cig /ā+oṃ badz+ra me dhe ( < a > nṛ taṃ ) ke āḥhūṃ/ rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi a mṛ ta/ /dug lnga gnas sgyur ye shes bsgrub pa'i rdzas/ /ro mchog yon tan kun dang ldan pa ni/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la mchod par bgyi/ /ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba pañtsa ā mṛ ta khā hi/ bde gshegs rgyal ba rgya mtsho ni/ /yab yum gnyis med mkha' gsang las/ /'khril sbyor byang chub sems kyis mchod/ /bde ba'i ro mnyam mchod par bzhes/ /ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bho dhi tsit+ta gu h+ya pū tsa (< a > pū dza ) me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ sna tshogs chos rnams ma skyes mnyam pa'i ngang*/ /snang srid 'khor 'das sgyu ma'i mchod sprin ni/ /chos sku stong pa mtshan med smon pa med/ /gdod nas rnam dag zhi ba'i dbyings su 'bul/ /ā+oṃ sarba dharma kā ya āḥhūṃ/ chos nyid ye shes mnyam pa'i ngang*/ /rang bzhin yon tan lhun gyis grub/ /thugs rje yid bzhin nor bu 'dra/ /phyag 'tshal gdod ma'i mgon po la/

/chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /nyon mongs gti mug rnam sbyong zhing*/ /nam mkha'i khams ni rnam par dag /phyag 'tshal rnam snang yab yum la/ /me long ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /nyon mongs zhe sdang rnam sbyong zhing*/ /chu yi khams ni rnam par dag / phyag 'tshal mi bskyod yab yum la/ /mnyam nyid ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /nyon mongs nga rgyal rnam sbyong zhing*/ /sa yi khams ni rnam par dag /phyag 'tshal rin 'byung yab yum la/ /kun rtog ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /nyon mongs 'dod chags rnam sbyong zhing*/ /me yi khams ni rnam par dag /phyag 'tshal snang mtha' yab yum la/ /bya grub ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /nyon mongs phrag dog rnam sbyong zhing*/ /rlung gi khams ni rnam par dag /phyag 'tshal don grub yab yum la/ /bcu drug ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /gzung 'dzin sgrib pa rnam sbyong zhing*/ / rnam shes tshogs brgyad rnam par dag /phyag 'tshal sems dpa' yab yum la/ /tshad med ye shes ngo bo nyid/ khams bzhi'i dri ma rnam sbyong zhing*/ /'byung bzhi'i sgo ni rnam par dag /phyag 'tshal sgo ba yab yum la/ /pha rol phyin drug ngo bo nyid/ /'gro drug bag chags rnam sbyong zhing*/ /tshogs drug rnam shes rnam par dag /phyag 'tshal thub pa drug la'o/ /zhi las ye shes rnam 'phros pa/ /'jigs gzugs khro bo'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /lnga bcu rtsa brgyad 'bar ba'i sku/ /phyag 'tshal dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor la/ /sa dang ye shes zhing khams na/ /'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das tshul/ /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad na/ /bzhugs pa'i 'gro ba kun la bstod/ /ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ/ gtor ma'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar bcud ye shes kyi bdud rtsi ri dang rgya mtshor mnyam pas gang bar gyur/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ i daṃ gh+ri na bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di/ bla ma bde gshegs rigs lnga zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul lo/

/tshe las 'das pa'i sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag nas myur du mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgya bar mdzad du gsol/ ā+oṃ a ha ri ni sa bha liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mkha' 'gro dpa' bo dpa' mo dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad la 'bul lo/ /tshe las 'das pa'i sa dang lam gyi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ ā+oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma naṃ a d+yā nud pat+pa na twad ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ yul lha gzhi bdag gi tshogs thams cad la 'bul lo/ /tshe las 'das pa'i sgrib pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ ā+oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma naṃ a d+yā nud pan na twad ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhāḥ 'gro ba rigs drug gnod byed lan chags bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu dang bcas pa la 'bul lo/ /tshe las 'das pa la lan chags pa thams cad khyer nas gnod pa dang 'tshe ba thams cad zhi bar mdzod cig /ā+oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ni a d+yā nut+pan na tod ā+oṃ āḥhūm̐phaṭa swā hāḥ dus las 'das pa'i gtsor byas bar do na gnas pa'i sems can thams cad la 'bul lo/ /bar do'i sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral nas myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig /na mo bdag gis bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs dang*/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs pa/ /thogs pa med par 'byung 'gyur shog /sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ /dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ /rang gi sems ni yongs su gdul/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*/ /ngo bo gnyis med gnas med pa/ / de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/

/ 'on kyang skyob ba'i sras su skye/ /de ltar chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sgrib pa gnyis byang ste/ myur du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig /ces brjod nas skabs 'dir/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du dbang blang ngo*/ /tshe 'das la dbang bskur te/ sgrib pa sbyong ba'i thog mar rten bskyed pa la thugs gtad par zhu/ ā+oṃ badz+ra kro ta h+ya gh+ri wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ swa bha wa bi shud+dha3 sarba dharma swa bhā wa bi shu dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang*/ zla ba'i steng du/ nṛ yongs su gyur pa las/ tshe 'das de nyid kyi phung po khams dang skye mched la sogs pa gson gyi dus na ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du yong bar gyur/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs kyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi rgyal po khro bo rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ gzungs sngags kyi rgyal mo khro mo rnams kyis bden pa dang*/ chos nyid rang bzhin gyi rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang*/ kun rdzob rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba zab mo'i bden pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin gyi rlabs kyis/ 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol du tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba'i rnam par shes pa las kyi dbang gis khams gsum 'gro ba rigs drug skye gnas rnam pa bzhi/ srid pa bar ma do/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i char gtogs pa/ gang na gnas kyang skad cig thang cig yud tsam gcig la rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig /ā+oṃ ḍāk+ki dza hūṃ/ zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ rnam shes 'od kyi rnam pa nam mkhar bsams la/ ā+oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ni sarba pā paṃ a pa na ye hūṃ/ sdig pa sbyangs te/

dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs rten la bstim/ /ā+oṃ sarba pā paṃ bhi shā dha ni hūṃ/ /ā+oṃ sarba bid tra thā/ ā+oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi bi po ta ya sarba a pa ya bhan+dha ni/ pra mo k+ṣa ya sarba a pa ya ghan+dhe bh+ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa ma ya tra thā/ ā+oṃ badz+ra bhan+dha tra thā/ ā+oṃ sarba bid badz+ra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha dz+nyā na sa ma ye hūṃ/ rnam par shes pa a dkar po dri ma med pa sbyangs du rung bar gyur/ /thog mar gtor ma bskor zhing zhi bas sbyong ba ni/ /ā+oṃ sarba sarba bi g+naṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+ya/ sarba tad khaṃ/ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa hi maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ tshe las 'das pa'i sdig pa sbyong ba la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs rnams gtor ma 'dis brdan par gyis la song zhig /ces pa gsum dang*/ ting lo dang chang bus bskor zhing*/ suṃ bha ni/ ting lo 'dis snang ba gyis changs bu 'dis lam rgyags gyis la song zhig /ces pas zhi drag phyed ma dang*/ gu gul gyis bdug cing rdo rje dril bu gsil la/ hūṃ ye shes bskal pa'i me la sogs pas khro bo mang po byon par bsam la/ hūṃ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrogs shing*/ /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ā+oṃ suṃ bha nis bgegs rnams rgya mtsho'i mthar bskrad/ ā+oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na/ ma thā da ha pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa kyis me ris mtshams bcad par gyur/ rten gyi g.yas su me/ g.yon du chu/ mdun du til bzhag nas/ snying ga'i sdig sgrib kaṃ nag po'i rnam pa sna sgor sdig pa rwa can du gyur pa/ mtheb srin gyis til la thim pa g.yas g.yon gyi ye shes kyi me dang chur bor bas dag par bsam zhing*/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bha smin ku ru ye swāhā/ che ge'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shan+ting ku ru ye swāhā/ sngags bzlas pa'i bye mas brab pas sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsam zhing*/

ā+oṃ dzi na dzi ka laṃ te sha ra te s+t+waṃ/ hūṃ badz+ra ḍhṛ ka muṃ dhartu shwa ra ti s+t+waṃ/ swā rat+na dhṛ ka maṃ mo ha ra ti s+t+waṃ/ aṃ a ro lika/ pyaṃ ra ga ra ti s+t+waṃ/ hā pra dz+nyā dhṛ ka taṃ badz+ra ra ti s+t+waṃ/ ā+oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho/ ā+oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ sarba pa paṃ bishwa dha ni badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ sarba karma a wa ra ṇa bhasmiṃ ku ru hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ bh+ruṃ bhi na sha ya/ a wa ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ bh+ruṃ bi sho dha ya a wa ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ ta ka ta ka ha na ha na a wa ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ sruṃ sa ra sa ra pra sa ra pra sa ra a war ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ sarba a wa ra ṇa ni bi pho ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ bh+ri ta bh+ri ta sarba a wa ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ tra tha tra tha sarba a wa ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ tshin+dha tshin+dha sarba a wa ra ṇa ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he dun hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ga te he dun hūṃ phaṭa/ ā+oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba raya ga he he dun hūṃ phaṭa/ tshe las 'das pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shan+ting ku ru ye swāhā/ lha'i ngos su me long la khrus gsol zhing*/ /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan/ /thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med/ /byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te/ /ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ye shrī hūṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la/ /rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu/ /yid 'ong laigs par gang bas glu dang ni/ /rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ye shrī hūṃ/

de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos/ /gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o/ /de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i/ /na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul/ /ā+oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrī a/ kā ya bhi sho dha na ye swā hā/ zhes gsol ba'i chu las bum du blugs par rnam rgyal gyi chu'ang bsres nas/ ming byang la bkru zhing*/ /'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu/ /ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*/ /gtong ba dri yis legs bgos chu/ khrus legs mdzad kyi khrus bgyi 'o/ /'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu/ khrims 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*/ /tshul khrims dri yis legs bgos chu/ khrus legs mdzad kyi khrus bgyi 'o/ /'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu/ khong khro'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*/ /bzod pa dri yis legs bgos chu/ khrus legs mdzad kyi khrus bgyi 'o/ /'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu/ /le lo'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*/ / brtson 'grus dri yis legs bgos chu/ khrus legs mdzad kyi khrus bgyi'o/ / 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu/ /rnam g.yeng dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*/ / bsam gtan dri yis legs bgos chu/ khrus legs mdzad kyi khrus bgyi 'o/ / 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu/ /shes 'chal dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*/ /shes rab dri yis legs bgos chu/ khrus legs mdzad kyi khrus bgyi 'o/ /chu bo drug gis khrus byas pas/ /bag chags rnam drug sbyong mdzad cing*/ /gang la nyes pa mi mnga' ba/ khrus legs mdzad la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /dri chu drug gis khrus byas pas/ /dri ma rnam drug sbyong mdzad cing*/ /rgya chen yon tan drug ldan pa'i/ khrus legs mdzad la nyes mi mnga'/ /dri ma rnam drug dag pa yis/ /yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa'i/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod don du/ /dad pas bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.a/ che ge mo'i pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi mi mthun pa'i phyogs drug zhi nas pha rol tu phyin pa drug yongs su rdzogs par gyur cig

/'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'di dag tshe 'das dug gsum ste/ /bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'/ /sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'di dag tshe 'das dug gsum ste/ /skyob pa'i dam chos dug mi mnga'/ /dam chos bden pas dug bcom mo/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/ /'di dag tshe 'das dug gsum ste/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun dug mi mnga'/ /dge 'dun bden pas dug bcom mo/ /che ge mo'i nyon mongs pa dug lnga dug gsum thams cad dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pas shan+ting ku ru ye swāhā/ yang 'byung ba bzhis bkru zhing*/ /sa ni dug gi pha yin te/ /sa ni dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas/ / dug gsum sa yi nang du song*/ /chu ni dug gi pha yin te/ /chu ni dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas/ /dug gsum chu yi nang du song*/ /me ni dug gi pha yin te/ /me ni dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas/ /dug gsum me yi nang du song*/ /rlung ni dug gi pha yin te/ /rlung ni dug gi ma yang yin/ /bden pa'i bden tshig 'di brjod pas/ /dug gsum rlung gi nang du song*/ /ā+oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.a/ che ge mo'i 'byung ba'i dug thams cad 'byung ba bzhi'i nang du shān+ting ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes bkrus nas shis pa brjod pa ni/ gang la ser sna rnam chags pa/ /rnam 'joms dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*/ /thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams/ /thar pa'i lam du 'dzud mdzad cing*/ /chos rnams thams cad ston pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /gang phyir bde la mnga' mdzad des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi/

/thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun/ /bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi/ /sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing*/ /gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig chos rnams mngon sum gyur/ /gtsang zhing bkru ba mi mnga' la/ /gsum gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pa/ /phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur cig /don grub tshogs kyang grub pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni/ /nags tshal bcas par rab g.yos te/ /sems can rab dga' mdzad pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /byang chub snying por gshegs pa na/ /sa dag rnam drug g.yos gyur cing*/ /bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnam gsung zhing*/ /thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed/ /thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing*/ tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pas des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas khyed la bde legs mdzad/ / brgya byin tshangs pa'i lha rnams dang*/ /'byung po kun gyi bde legs ni/ khyed la rtag tu sbyin gyur cig /sangs rgyas bsod nams mthu dag dang*/ /lha rnams kun gyi bsam pa yis/ khyed kyi 'dod don gang yin pa'i/ /don de de ring 'grub gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog /rkang bzhi khyed chag bde legs shog khyed cag lam 'gro bde legs shog /phyir 'ong dag kyang bde legs shog /nyin mo bde legs mtshan bde legs/ /nyi ma'i gung la bde legs shing*/ /nyin mtshan kun tu bde legs shog khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig /rkang gnyis khyed cag bde legs shog

/tshe las 'das pa che ge mos gtso byas pa'i skye dgu thams cad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal zhing shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig /ces brjod nas byang bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol tu tshe las 'das pas gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje 'chang zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dang por me tog phog pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yid dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba kun bzang rigs lnga'i gtso/ /sems dpa' sems ma sgo skyong thub pa drug/ zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi/ /gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang*/ /byang chub lcam dral lha dang lha mo'i tshogs/ /rdo rje pho nya mkha' 'gro shug 'gror bcas/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi/ /rgyal sras nyan thos rang sangs rgyas pa'i tshogs/ /rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ongs pa dang*/ / slob dang mi slob bsod nams zhing rnams la/ /gus pas phyag 'tsha' skyabs su nye bar mchi/ /thog med dus nas 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'dir/ /ma rig dbang gis 'khrul zhing 'khyams pa'i tshe/ /lus ngag yid kyis sdig pa ci bgyis pa/ /ma lus da lta so sor bshags par bgyi/ /nyan thos rang rgyal theg pa che la sogs/ /so so'i bstan pa rgya mtsho'i 'dul khrims las/ / 'gal zhing nongs pa'i dngos po ci mchis pa/ /ma lus da lta so sor bshags par bgyi/ /shes dang spyad dang dang du blangs la sogs/ /nyi shu rtsa lnga rtsa ba yan lag bcas/ /bsrungs mtshams dus las yal ba mchis so 'tshal/

/ma lus da lta so sor bshags par bgyi/ /mdor na nyes ltung sdig pa'i tshogs kun bshags/ /dge la yi rang 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ / mya ngan mi 'da' rtag par gsol ba 'debs/ /'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pas phyag 'tshal nas/ de nas tshe 'das kyis dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ sa gzhi spos kyis byugs shing me tog bkram/ /ri rab gling bzh-i nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis/ /'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /ā+oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūṃ zhes pa dang*/ e ma dus gsum rgyal ba kun tu bzang*/ / rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dgongs su gsol/ /tshe 'das khyed kyi rjes su 'jug /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro dang*/ /so thar byang sems dam tshig rnams/ /thar pa'i grong du 'jug bya'i phyir/ mgon pos bdag la gnang du gsol/ /ces brjod par bsam nas me tog dor ba'i lan du/ e ma snod dang ldan pa'i bu/ /gsang sngags cho ga khyed la bstan/ /'das dang ma byon da ltar gyis/ /sangs rgyas ma lus thams cad kyang*/ /gsang sngags cho ga 'di mkhyen pas/ /kun kyang sangs rgyas thob pa yin/ /kun bzang rgyal ba rigs lnga yis/ /bdud kyi dpung yang 'di yis bcom/ /de ltar khyod kyis thob bya'i phyir/ /'di yi rjes su kun zhugs mdzod/ /ces brjod nas sdom pa byin/ / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dgongs/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang*/ /zhi ba chags bral dam pa'i chos rnams dang*/ /tshogs mchog 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su nye bar mchi/ / kun bzang rigs lnga'i lha tshogs la/ /'di bzung bla med byang chub bar/ / gus pa'i yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo chos skyong bcas/ / byang chub sems dpa' slob dpon la/ /bdag ni gus pas skyabs su mchi/

/ bla ma kun bzang sbyan snga ru/ /lus ngag yid kyis gzhan rnams la/ /gnod pa las ldog dge ba bsgrub/ /dge tshul dge slong byang chub sems/ /so sor thar pa'i sdom pa la/ /bdag ni rgyun du gnas shing bsrung*/ /zhes pa gsum dang*/ /ho bla ma kun bzang dgongs su gsol/ /'di bzung byang chub ma thob bar/ /'gro drug sems can thams cad la/ ma dang bu yi 'du shes kyis/ / ma brgal ba rnams bsgral ba dang*/ /ma grol dgrol dang dbugs dbyung phyir/ /smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed de/ /sngon gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyang*/ /sdom pa la ni gnas pa ltar/ 'di bzung 'khor ba ma stongs par/ /bla med 'jug pa'i byang chub sems/ /tshe 'das bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ / pha rol phyin drug slob cing bsgrub/ /brtson 'grus bdag gis thams cad bsgral/ /kun don tshul khrims gsum rtag bsrung*/ /bdag gis sems bskyed sdoms gzung nas/ /ma grol dgrol dang ma brgal bsgral/ /dbugs dbyung mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces pa gsum dang*/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /tshe 'das la ni dgongs su gsol/ /deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dkon mchog gsum ni mi gtang ngo*/ /rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ /rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya dang*/ /byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ /rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ / sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /pad+ma rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ /theg pa gsum dang chos rnams bshad/ /las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ /'gro ba'i don la brtson par bya/ /yar mchod gus shing mar la brtse/ /rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig bsrung*/ /rtsa ba bzhi las 'da' mi bya/ /zhes pa gsum gyis rjes la/ gdong g.yogs yid kyis bcings la gsol ba btab pa/ kye khro bo mi bzad 'jigs pa'i sku/ /mtshon cha sna tshogs phyag na bsnams/ /bdag cag 'khor ba las bsgral phyir/ khyed kyis gnang ste gtong du gsol/

/ces pa dang*/ khyed su yin ci byed dris la/ bdag ni skal ldan rigs kyi bu gcig po lags/ dpal rigs kyi bdag po la dbang zhu/ zhes lan smras par bsams la/ bgegs bskrad/ yang*/ kye rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pa dang*/ /bla ma yid dam mkha' 'gro dgongs/ /sgo ba chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /sgo phye thar pa'i grong bstan 'tshal/ /zhes pa gsum dang*/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spangs na ni/ /skyob ba gzhan nas mi mnga' bas/ khyed kyi thugs rjes bdag la stsol/ /zhes pa gsum dang*/ e ma khyod ni snod mchog dam pa ste/ khyod 'dod pa ni bdag gis sbyin/ /zhes dang*/ bdag ni 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi/ /dngos grub bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis/ / smin cing grol bar 'dod pas na/ /thugs rjes bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ /gsum gyi rjes la/ e ma e ma rigs kyi bu/ khyod ni las zad 'khrul ba zhig /rigs kyi bu mchog khyod yin pas/ /ngas khyod kun bzang rigs lnga yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'jug cing ye shes dbab/ /dngos grub thams cad khyod kyis thob/ /dngos grub dkyil 'khor 'di dag ni/ /ma mthong ba la smras pa na/ /dam tshig nyams te dmyal bar ltung*/ /rigs lnga ye shes rnam pa lnga/ khyod kyi snying la zhugs pa ste/ /'di smras ye shes lha dang bral/ /'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig chu/ /dam tshig nyams na sregs par byed/ /bsrung na dngos grub thams cad thob/ /dam tshig bdud rtsi'i chu 'di 'thung*/ /ā+oṃ a mṛ ta dam las ma 'da' swā hā/ khyod kyis ston pa rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas nga yin pas/ ngas bka' bsgo ba las ma 'da' zhig /'das na rdo rje'i dmyal bar skyes nas thon pa'i dus med do/ /zhes pas bdud rtsi 'thor nas/ bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ tshe 'das kyi snying nang du thim par bsams la/ ā+oṃ badz+ra pra be sha ya pra be sha ya hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes pas rol mo dkrol lo/ /tshe 'das gsol ba 'debs par bsams nas/

kya ེ shar sgo srung ba'i sgo ba lcags kyu ma/ shar gyi sgo 'di phyes la ni/ /tshe 'das yi dam lha dang sprod/ /kye lho sgo srung ba'i sgo ba zhags pa ma/ /lho yi sgo 'di phyes la ni/ /tshe 'das yi dam lha dang sprod/ /nub sgo srung pa'i sgo ba lcags sgrog ma/ /nub kyi sgo 'di phyes la ni/ /tshe 'das yi dam lha dang sprod/ /byang sgo srung ba'i sgo ba dril bu ma/ /byang gi sgo 'di phyes la ni/ /tshe 'das yi dam lha dang sprod/ /ces brjod nas me tog dor te/ kye bde gshegs rigs lnga'i pho brang du/ /'brel ba'i me tog 'di dor bas/ /'brel ba gang yod lha dang bdag 'phrad shog /ā+oṃ puṣ+pe si ti (< a > sid+dhi ) s+t+waṃ/ zhes dor nas/ ston pa rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas kyis/ khyod kyi ma rig 'khor ba'i mig /ye shes spyan du dbye ba ltar/ /de bzhin khyod kyis 'gro ba rnams/ /ye shes spyan du 'byed par shog /ā+oṃ tsak+ṣu swāhā/ zhes yid kyis gdongs g.yogs phyes la/ e ma tshe 'das rigs kyi bu/ khyod ni sdig pa kun las grol/ /dkyil 'khor chen po 'di la ltos/ /lus ngag yid kyis dad pa bskyed/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ / dngos grub thams cad khyod kyis thob/ /dam tshig sngags la brtson par gyis/ /kye rigs kyi bu rdul tshon gyi dal 'di ni rten lha'i gzhal yas khang ste/ phung po khams dang skye mched mtshon/ de na bzhugs pa'i lha ni/ rang gi sems rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas su bzhugs par dran par gyis shig /ces brjod nas/ yang maṇ+ḍal phul te/ /kun bzang yab yum ye shes dbang*/ /bdag la bskur bar mdzad du gsol/ /ces gsum brjod dus/ me tog gang la phog pa 'di/ /sngon nas khyod kyi yi dam lha/ /rtag tu bsgom dang bsgrub par gyis/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe si ti (< a > sid+dhi ) s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas me tog bcings la/ tshe 'das rdo rje sems dpar bsams la/ bum pa spyi bor 'dzin pas/

hūṃ gzugs kyi phung po rnam dag cing*/ /nyon mongs zhe sdang sbyong byed pa'i/ /me long lta bu'i ye shes kyis/ /dpal ldan sku yi dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ 'o rigs kyi bu khyod la chu 'di gtad cing bkrus pa tsam gyis/ lus kyi sgrib pa thams cad dag nas 'dir sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku'i dbang thob pa yin no/ khyod kyi gzugs kyi phung po rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du sangs rgyas te/ chu'i khams mā ma kī'i rang bzhin du gnas 'gyur nas/ zhe sdang me long lta bu'i ye shes su grol te/ sangs rgyas rdo rje rigs kyi sku 'gyur ba med pa thob nas 'gro ba thams cad kyi don byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa dang*/ snang ba mtha' yas su bsams te rdo rje bzung nas/ hūṃ 'du shes phung po rnam dag cing*/ /nyon mongs 'dod chags sbyong byed pa'i/ /so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes kyis/ /dpal ldan gsung gi dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ pad+ma a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ 'o rigs kyi bu khyod kyi lag tu rdo rje 'di gtad pa tsam gyis/ 'dir ngag gi sgrib pa dag nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi dbang thob pa yin no/ /'du shes kyi phung po snang ba mtha' yas nyid du sangs rgyas te me'i khams kyang gos dkar mo'i rang bzhin du dag nas/ 'dod chags so sor rtog pa'i ye shes nyid du grol te/ sangs rgyas pad+ma rigs kyi gsung 'gags med pa'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs thob nas 'gro ba'i don byed par 'gyur ro/ / zhes pa dang*/ rnam snang du bsams nas ming 'dogs par mos shing*/ hūṃ rnam shes phung po rnam dag cing*/ /nyon mongs gti mug sbyong byed pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyis/ /dpal ldan thugs kyi dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ bud+dha abhi ṣiñtsa ā+oṃ/ 'o rigs kyi bu khyod la ming che ge mo zhes bya ba btags pa tsam gyis/ 'dir yid kyi sgrib pa dag nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi dbang thob pa yin no/

/rnam par shes pa yang rnam par snang mdzad du sangs rgyas te/ nam mkha'i khams kyang chos kyi dbyings phyug mar dag nas/ gti mug chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su grol te/ sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs 'khrul pa med pa chos kyi sku thob nas 'gro ba'i don byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa dang*/ rin 'byung du bsams nas dbu rgyan thogs nas/ hūṃ tshor pa'i phung po rnam dag cing*/ nyon mongs nga rgyal sbyong byed pa'i/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes kyis/ /dpal ldan yon tan dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñtsa trāṃ/ 'o rigs kyi bu khyod la dbu rgyan 'di bskon pa tsam gyis/ 'dir lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa dag nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan gyi dbang thob pa yin no/ /tshor ba'i phung po rin chen 'byung ldan nyid du sangs rgyas te/ sa'i khams kyang sangs rgyas spyan du dag nas/ nga rgyal mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes su grol te/ sangs rgyas rin chen rigs kyi yon tan thams cad mkhyen pa thob nas/ 'gro ba'i don byed par 'gyur ro/ zhes pa dang*/ /don grub tu bsams nas dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūṃ 'du byed phung po rnam dag cing*/ /nyon mongs phrag dog sbyong byed pa'i/ /bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyis//dpal ldan phrin las dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa a/ 'o rigs kyi bu khyod la dril bu 'di gtad pa tsam gyis 'dir lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa ma lus pa dag nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las kyi dbang thob pa yin no/ /'du byed kyi phung po yang don yod grub par sangs rgyas te/ rlung gi khams kyang dam tshig sgrol mar dag nas/ phrag dog bya ba grub pa'i ye shes su grol te/ sangs rgyas don yod grub pa'i phrin las thogs pa med pa 'grub nas 'gro ba'i don byed par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa dang*/ kun tu bzang por bsams te/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/
ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ thabs dang shes rab dbyer med cing*/ /snang stong dbyer med 'di zung la/ /stong nyid snying rje'i snying po yis/

/ kun bzang rdo rje 'dzin khyod kyis/ /'gro kun rjes su 'dzin par mdzod/ /'o rigs kyi bu khyod la rdo rje dang dril bu 'di gtad pa tsam gyis/ 'dir thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa bon thebs nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin kun tu bzang po rig pa'i rtsal dbang thob pa yin no/ /rang gi sems skye ba med pa chos kyi skur sangs rgyas te/ 'di ltar snang ba thams cad ma spangs gnas su dag nas/ sku gsum 'bral ba med pas 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa 'grub par 'gyur ro/ / zhes pa dang*/ rnam rgyal gyi bum pa 'dzin pas/ hūṃ rdo rje sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das/ /mā ma kī yi phyag rgya bum pa ste/ /gnyis med byang chub sems kyi chus/ /rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /snang ba mtha' yas bcom ldan 'das/ /gos dkar mo yi phyag rgya bum pa ste/ /gnyis med byang chub sems kyi chus/ /rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'das/ /kun tu bzang mo'i phyag rgya bum pa ste/ /gnyis med byang chub sems kyi chus/ /rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /rin chen 'byung ldan bcom ldan 'das/ /sangs rgyas spyan ma'i phyag rgya bum pa ste/ /gnyis med byang chub sems kyi chus/ /rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /don yod grub pa bcom ldan 'das/ /dam tshig sgrol ma'i phyag rgya bum pa ste/ /gnyis med byang chub sems kyi chus/ /rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur ro/ /ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki ni si ti (< a > sid+dhi ) pha la hūṃ/ ā+oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.aḥha ri ni sa a bhi ṣiñtsa bh+ru?ṃ/ sid+dhi pha la hūṃ ā/ 'o rigs kyi bu khyod la dbang thams cad brtan par byed pa bum pa'i dbang 'di bskur ba tsam gyis/ snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas khang gi rang bzhin phung po khams dang skye mched lha dang lha mor gnas gyur pa yin pas/ phyi nang snod bcud thams cad la brnyas pa byas na ltung bar 'gyur bas dag snang dang mos pa gyis la mchod pa dang bstod pa la dga' ba dang ngo shes par gyis shig

/ces pa dang*/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan bstan la/ 'o rigs kyi bu khyod la rigs lnga'i sku 'di bstan pa tsam gyis/ ye shes lnga'i ngo bor sangs rgyas pa yin no/ /de yang nyon mongs pa rang bzhin gyis dag cing ye shes lnga rgyas pas/ rang bzhin gyi don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i brda yin no/ /zhes pa dang*/ de ltar brda yi ngo sprod kyang*/ /logs na yod pa ma yin te/ /rang gi lus sems 'di la tshang*/ /'khor 'das rig pa'i ye shes te/ /sku lnga ye shes lhun gyis grub/ /sangs rgyas gzhan du ma 'tshol cig / ces pa dang*/ e ma tshe 'das bu nyon cig /thun mong skyabs 'gro nas brtsams pa'i/ /so thar byang sems bslab bya dang*/ /rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig kun/ /byang chub ma thob bar du ni/ /srog gi phyir yang ma gtang zhig /dam tshig nyams na bskal pa ru/ /ngan song gsum nas thar mi srid/ / de phyir srungs shig rigs kyi bu/ 'o khyod kyis gsang sngags kyi dbang thams cad rdzogs par thob pa yin pas dad pa dang dam tshig thams cad legs par bsrungs ba la brtson par mdzod cig /ces brjod nas/ shin tu dben zhing skal ba mchog rab dang ldan pa la dbang lhag ma'ang bskur zhing*/ thun mong pa thams cad de nas maṇ+ḍal phul lo/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la/ /deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /lus dang longs spyod kun gyis mchod/ khyed kyi rjes su gzung mdzod la/ /srid pa'i rgyal mtsho las brgal mdzod/ /ces gtang rag phul ba dang*/ slar yang mchod cing bstod pa/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ongs rgyan phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa//mos blos rten gyi lha la mchod par bgyi/ /bzhes shig bla med thar lam grub par mdzod/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa ka ma gu+u ṇa pū tsi te āḥhūṃ/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan yid 'ongs ldan//mos blos rten gyi lha la mchod par bgyi/

/bzhes shig bla med thar lam grub par mdzod/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shab+ta ka ma gu+u ṇa pū tsi te āḥhūṃ/ phyogs dus kun na tsan dan sbrul snying dang*/ /a gar nag sogs dbang po tshims byed dri/ /mos blos rten gyi lha la mchod par bgyi/ /bzhes shig bla med thar lam grub par mdzod/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ghan+dhe ka ma gu ṇa pū tsi ti āḥhūṃ/ phyogs dus kun na bcud dang ror ldan pa'i/ /lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis kun/ /mos blos rten gyi lha la mchod par bgyi/ / bzhes shig bla med thar lam grub par mdzod/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rā sa ka ma gu+u ṇa pū tsi te āḥhūṃ/ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i/ /reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshims byed rnams/ /mos blos rten gyi lha la mchod par bgyi/ /bzhes shig bla med thar lam grub par mdzod/ /ā+oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta par+she ka ma gu ṇa pū tsi te (< a > pū dzi te ) āḥhūṃ/ ye nas rnam dag chos sku dag pa las/ /sna tshogs thabs kyi gzugs skur rnam sprul zhing*/ /'gro ba'i don gnyis lhun gyis grub mdzad pa/ /rdo rje sems dpa' che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod nas/ nub tha ma la 'dir byang bu'i rnam shes nam mkhar hūm̐ du bsam la 'og tu me sbar te/ /gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu/ /phung po lnga yi bud shing la/ /rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me sbar ro//'byung ba bzhi yi bud shing la/ /lha mo bzhi yi me sbar ro/ /rnam shes brgyad kyi bud shing la/ /byang chub sems dpa'i me sbar ro/ /skye mched drug gi bud shing la/ /thub pa drug gi me sbar ro/ khams dang phung po'i bud shing la/ khro bo ye shes me sbar ro/ /lus ngag yid gsum bud shing la/ /rgyal ba'i sku gsum me spar ro/ /sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan pa/ /'gro ba'i don du 'grub par shog /ces bsregs nas/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing

du/ /dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba/ /dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyis/ /rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa/ /tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam/ /mthong ba'i lam dang sgom pa'i lam/ /bla na med pa'i khyad par lam/ / byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam/ /rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la/ /brten nas sdig pa kun sbyangs nas/ /'phags pa'i lam der 'gro bar shog /ā+oṃ rad ne rad ne/ /rad na sa ma bhā we/ rad na mā la/ rad na ki bi shud+dhe/ sho dha ya/ sarba pā paṃ swāhā/ pad+ma ོ 'dam gyis ma gos ltar/ srid gsum dri mas ma gos pa'i/ /srid pa'i pad+mo las byung ba'i/ /bde ba can du skye bar shog /ā+oṃ pad+me pad+me pad+ma saṃ bha we/ su khaṃ bha ra bha ya/ gha tsha ru swāhā/ rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing dga' ba der/ pad+mo dam pa shin tu mdzes las skyes/ /snang ba mtha' yas rgyal bas mngon sum du/ /lung bstan pa yang tshe 'das der thob shor/ ces me tog 'thor bas/ nub phyogs pad+ma brtsegs pa rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing du skyes te/ ston pa 'od dpag med 'khor bcas mchod cing lung bstan nas/ /slar yang steng gi nam mkha' drin lan gyi tshul gyis me tog gi 'char 'bebs shing*/ ched du brjod pa/ e ma sangs rgyas ya ེ sangs rgyas/ /e ma sangs rgyas mdzad pa legs/ /gang phyir ngan song bdag cag sbyangs/ /byang chub spyod pa nyid la bzhag /sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i ston pa med/ /chos dang 'dra ba'i skyob pa med/ /dge 'dun 'dra ba'i zhing med do/ / sngags dang 'dra ba'i 'dren pa med/ /e ma sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni/ / sangs rgyas mdzad pa ya mtshan che/ zhes brjod nas slar bde ba can du song ste sangs rgyas par gyur/ de nas skabs 'dir tshogs kyi dga' ba byas la/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ/ mchod pa'i sprin phung nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ /chu dang thang las skyes pa yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i me tog 'di/ /me long ye shes brnyes la 'bul/ /tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/

ā+oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /bdug spos dam pa 'di dag ni/ /mnyam nyid ye shes brnyes la 'bul/ /tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ ā+oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūṃ/ mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad cing*/ /phyogs kun snang ba'i mar me 'di/ /kun rtog ye shes brnyes la 'bul/ /tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ ā+oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūṃ/ lhan cig skyes dang sbyar ba yi/ /dri yi mchod pa 'di dag ni/ /bya grub ye shes brnyes la 'bul/ /tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūṃ/ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa'i/ /zhal zas mchog gi bshos gtsang 'di/ /chos dbyings ye shes brnyes la 'bul/ /tshe 'das don du bzhes su gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra ni wi te āḥhūṃ/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho sras bcas la/ /snang srid 'dod yon mchod pa'i sprin/ /bdud rtsi bde chen bla na med/ /ye shes mchog gi mchod par bgyi/ /ā+oṃ ma mṛ ta pū tsa sarba āḥhūṃ/ hūṃ zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa yi/ /rang bzhin rnam dag dkyil 'khor du/ /phung po nyon mongs gnas gyur pa'i/ /bde gshegs bzhi bcu gnyis la 'dud/ /che mchog gdod nas rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /gar dgu'i rol par rab dgyes shing*/ /sna tshogs rnams par 'phrul pa'i bdag khrag 'thung lnga bcu brgyad la 'dud/ /zhing dang dur khrod nye ba'i zhing*/ /gnas rnams la ni rab rgyu zhing*/ / mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /kun la rang bzhin gus phyag 'tshal/ /zhes pas bstod la/ sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad 'dir ni bde gyur cig /ston mchog dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/ /de dag thams cad 'dir ni bde gyur cig / zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa/ /chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir ba de legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba/

/de dag thams cad 'dir ni bde gyur cig tshogs kyi mchog rab lha mis mchod 'os pa/ / dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /ces pas me tog 'thor la/ gang yang bdag blo gti mug pas/ /legs byas 'di la nyes gyur gang*/ /de kun lus can skyabs gyur pa/ /bla ma mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /gang yang bdag cag rtsod pa'i dus/ /snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can du gyur pa lags pas/ /gzhung bzhin du yo byad ma tshogs pa dang*/ /ma 'byor pa ci mchis pa thams cad bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis bzod pa chen po mdzad du gsol/ gang yang bdag cag las dang po pa'i sems can du gyur pas/ ting nge 'dzin la dbang ma thob ste/ bying ba dang*/ rgod pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis cho ga nyams shing lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nor ba'i skyon dngos po ci mchis pa de dag bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis bzod pa chen po mdzad du gsol lo/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma yā/ ma nu pā la ya/ sarba sa twa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su twa ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shri yaḥku ru hūṃ/ ha ha ha ha ho/ bha wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra ma me muñtsa/ badz+rī bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ zhes brjod nas bsngo ba bya ba ni/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dal thams cad tshe las 'das pa la dgongs su gsol/ tshe las 'das pas dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge rtsa thams cad dang gang yang bdag cag gi tshe las 'das pa'i don du/ dkon mchog mchod cing dbang bskur/ 'byung po la gtor ma byin pa la sogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag 'jig rten 'di nas 'jig rten pha rol tu tshe las 'das pa che ge mos thog drangs/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can thams cad dang*/ thun mong gcig tu byas te/

'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rgud pa thams cad dang bral zhing*/ phun sum tshogs pa thams cad dang ldan te/ lha dang mi'i mchog rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig /de ma thob kyi bar du yang rnam par smin pa la re ba med pa'i sbyin pa gtong nus par gyur cig /srid par skye ba la 'dun pa thams cad dang bral ba'i tshul khrims bsrung nus par gyur cig /sems can thams cad la zha ེ 'gras pa med pa'i bzod pa bsgom nus par gyur cig/ dge ba'i chos ma lus pa myur du sdud pa'i brtson 'grus brtsam nus par gyur cig /gzugs med pa'i khams rnam par gsal ba'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam pa 'jog nus par gyur cig /thabs snying rje chen po dang ma bral ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i don rtogs shing khong du chud par gyur cig /de ltar gyur nas kyang sems can gyi don du rnam par thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig /de ma thob kyi bar du yang*/ bde 'gro mtho ris kyi 'jig rten lha dang mi rnams kyi nang du phyin par gyur cig /de yang mtho ris yon tan bdun dang ldan pa skyon gang yang med pa nyid thob par gyur cig khyad par du bla ma yang dag pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen mthun pa'i zhabs drung du skye bar gyur cig /de dag las theg pa chen po'i chos zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos thob par gyur cig /de'i don nyams su blangs nas sa dang lam thams cad yongs su rdzogs nas/ sku bzhi ye shes lnga dang ldan pa'i dpal kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang rin po che myur du thob par gyur cig /ces pa gsum brjod nas/ gson pa'i don du bsngo ba/ yang*/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad bdag cag rnams la dgongs su gsol/ gang yang bdag cag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di la brten nas/ rgyu sbyor ba yon gyi bdag pos gtso byas nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i sems can thams cad kyis/

rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig /de ma thob kyi bar du tshe 'di nyid la yang*/ nad dang gdon dang bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthun pa'i rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig /dge ba rgya chen gyur pa 'di yis ni/ /'gro ba'i nang du sangs rgyas rang byung shog /sngon gyis rgyal ba rnams kyis ma bsgral ba'i/ /skye bo'i tshogs rnams bdag gis sgrol bar shog /sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ / dge 'dun mi phyed 'dus pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdag gis ji ltar bsngos bzhin 'grub par shog /ces brjod nas/ ā+oṃ āḥhūṃ gis sku gsung thugs bsrungs nas nub tha ma la/ ā+oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsaul/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /ā+oṃ badz+ra mus ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hos bdag la thim par gyur/ de nas a kā ros byang shar nas rdo rje srin 'gros su byas te/ rdul tshon bsdus la/ las kyi rjes ma

ི mngon par byas nas/ tshom bu lnga bkod nas rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas dang*/ bkra shis kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pas shis pa brjod par bsams la me tog 'thor/ rol mo'i sgra sgrogs shing mgrin gcig tu/ ā+oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /bkra shis dang po des kyang ding 'dir bde legs shog /de yi nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skyed dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /bkra shis gnyis pa des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /bkra shis gsum pa des kyang der 'dir bde legs shog /bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang*/ /brgyud 'dzin nyi zla bzhin du gsal ba dang*/ /snyan pas nam mkha' bzhin du khyab pa yi//gsum po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang*/ /mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs las grol ba dang*/ / 'dod pa 'grub cing phun sum tshogs gyur pa'i/ /bzhi po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /lo brgya thub cing ston brgya mthong ba dang*/ /tshe ring nad med bde legs phun sum tshogs/ /theg pa mchog la nges par 'byung gyur pa'i/ /lnga po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims srung ba dang*/ /bzod pa sgom bzhin brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang*/ / mnyam par 'jog cing gnas lugs rtogs gyur pa'i/ /drug po des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /rnam par snang mdzad rgyal ba mi bskyod pa/ /rin chen 'byung ldan snang ba mtha' yas dang*/ /don yod grub bcas rigs lnga'i bkra shis gang*/

/bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /bde chen rnam dag chos dbyings gang chen mtsho/ /mkha' 'gra ོ rigs lnga ye shes sprin 'phro ba//snang srid rnam dag lha dang lha mo'i zhing*/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /ā+oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes pas/ me tog gtor la bkra shis su bya'o/ /snying po'i rtsa rgyud rdzogs pa rang byung las/ ji ltar gsungs bzhin de yi don bsdus nas/ phyi rabs skal ldan rnams kyis rtogs bya'i phyir/ /gangs ri thod dkar mgul du legs par bkod//bdag blo dri med nam mkha' yangs pa las/ /mang du thos pa'i 'od zer stong 'phro bas/ /blo gsal pad+ma rab tu kha phye nas/ /dad ldan rnams la las 'brel rtsal du snang*/ /dge ba de yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ /ma lus bde 'byung bde gshegs dbang po'i gnas/ /rang bzhin gdod ma'i gling du phyin gyur te//rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub gyur shog /gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba/ o rgyan gyi slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi thugs kyi 'od zer blo'i pad+mor phog pas kha bye ba'i rnal 'byor pa pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis/ ston gsum me tog dang 'bras bu smin pa'i tshe/ gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul o rgyan rdzong gi dben gnas dam par bkod pa rdzogs so/ /bha wan tu/ bkra shis// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen bka' 'bum/ (8)gzhan phan 'od kyi 'khor lo/ -PAGE 316--PAGE 317--PAGE 274-
